description: Add ``list-skills``, which lists a registry's skills with the name in each one's ``SKILL.md`` and the AI coding agents each is installed for, ``install-skill`` and ``uninstall-skill``, which install or update a skill, given by record ID or by record name with ``--record-name``, for detected AI coding agents (or one chosen with ``--agent``), in a folder named after its ``SKILL.md`` name and from the record's ``SKILL.md`` text when it has no package, and uninstall it again, and ``sign-out``, which revokes and deletes cached sign-ins, with browser sign-in to ``CUSTOM_JWT`` registries through ``--authorizer JWT`` on ``list-skills`` and ``install-skill``.
